diction: The diction of this poem is simple but very powerful.
这首诗的措辞简单却非常有力量。
remains: The remains of the ancient city attract many visitors every year.
古城遗址每年吸引许多游客前来参观。
granular: The soil here is granular and easy for plants to grow in.
这里的土壤呈颗粒状，很适合植物生长。
affable: Our new teacher is affable and always greets us with a smile.
我们的新老师和蔼可亲，总是微笑着和我们打招呼。
gist: I missed the details, but I got the gist of his speech.
我漏掉了细节，但我领会了他讲话的大意。
pensive: She sat by the window, pensive and silent all afternoon.
她整个下午都坐在窗边，沉思而沉默。
reliever: This medicine is a good pain reliever for headaches.
这种药是缓解头痛的好帮手。
venturesome: The venturesome boy climbed to the top of the tall rock.
那个敢于冒险的男孩爬到了高高的岩石顶端。
condole: We called to condole with our friend after his father passed away.
朋友的父亲去世后，我们打电话向他表示慰问。
assortment: The shop sells a wide assortment of fruits and snacks.
这家店出售各种各样的水果和零食。
recital: Her piano recital last night was praised by everyone in the hall.
昨晚她的钢琴独奏会得到了全场观众的称赞。
recurring: This recurring dream makes me wake up feeling nervous.
这个反复出现的梦让我醒来时感到紧张。
pleasing: The garden looks pleasing in every season of the year.
这座花园一年四季都令人赏心悦目。
inert: The injured dog lay inert on the road until help arrived.
受伤的狗一动不动地躺在路上，直到救援到来。
kerosene: In the past, many families used kerosene lamps at night.
过去，许多家庭晚上使用煤油灯。
gouge: He used a special tool to gouge a hole in the wood.
他用一种特制工具在木头上凿了个洞。
saucy: The saucy reply made the whole class burst into laughter.
那句俏皮的回答让全班哄堂大笑。
unbridgeable: The two sides could not agree because the gap between them seemed unbridgeable.
双方无法达成一致，因为他们之间的鸿沟似乎无法逾越。
amalgamation: The amalgamation of the two schools created a larger and better one.
两所学校合并后成了一所更大更好的学校。
garb: The dancers appeared in traditional garb for the festival.
舞者们身着传统服装出现在节日庆典上。
salon: She opened a hair salon near the train station last month.
上个月她在火车站附近开了一家美发沙龙。
languish: Without enough sunlight, the flowers languished in the corner of the room.
由于缺少阳光，花朵在房间角落里渐渐枯萎。
affinity: He has a natural affinity for languages and learns them quickly.
他对语言有天然的喜爱，学得很快。
suffragist: The suffragist gave speeches across the country to win women the vote.
这位女权运动者为争取妇女选举权在全国各地发表演讲。
laudable: His efforts to clean up the beach are truly laudable.
他清理海滩的努力确实值得称赞。
swindle: The stranger tried to swindle the old man out of his savings.
那个陌生人企图骗取老人的积蓄。
invertebrate: Earthworms are invertebrate animals that live in the soil.
蚯蚓是生活在土壤中的无脊椎动物。
influx: The city saw a large influx of tourists during the holiday.
假期期间这座城市迎来了大批游客。
ensconce: The cat ensconced itself in the softest corner of the sofa.
猫安坐在沙发最柔软的角落里。
antecede: The strange events seemed to antecede the storm by several days.
那些怪事似乎比暴风雨早了几天发生。
viral: The video went viral and millions of people watched it within a day.
这段视频迅速走红，一天之内数百万人观看了它。
biannual: The company holds biannual meetings in spring and autumn.
公司每年春秋两季各举行一次会议。
noxious: The factory was fined for releasing noxious gases into the air.
这家工厂因向空气中排放有害气体而被罚款。
vascular: Regular exercise is good for your vascular health.
经常锻炼有益于你的血管健康。
quiescent: The volcano has been quiescent for over a hundred years.
这座火山已经沉寂了一百多年。
gem: The ring was set with a small but perfect gem.
戒指上镶着一颗虽小却完美无瑕的宝石。
hemp: Hemp has long been used to make rope and strong cloth.
大麻长久以来被用来制作绳索和结实的布料。
caribou: The caribou travel hundreds of miles across the frozen north every winter.
北美驯鹿每年冬天要穿越冰冻的北方，跋涉数百英里。
eviscerate: The chef learned how to eviscerate a fish quickly and cleanly.
这位厨师学会了如何快速干净地取出鱼的内脏。
famish: We walked all morning without breakfast and were nearly famished by noon.
我们没吃早饭走了一上午，到中午时几乎饿坏了。
